page.layout: One column of running text, set narrow, with the page number and running head at the top. Below the last line, at the right, a catchword "pa-". No marginal notes.

main_text.p: dere, majora evitare pericula, non adeo meo judicio frequen-tia duella forent, si summo cum discrimine pugnare co-gantur duellatores, ut ita pe-riculi gravitate à proposito di-vellantur. Quo modo ferunt, prudentem quem exercitus imperatorem, quod conti-nuis interpellaretur preci-bus à duellantium pari, ve-niam ut eis depugnandi largi-retur, erexisse loco in aperto patibulum, ac petentibus li-centiam congrediendi concess-sisse, ea tamen conditione, ut uter eorum foret superstes in-terfecto adversario, etiam eo-dem illo in loco vitam laqueo finiret. Quod institutum ut intellexissent duellantes, ti-more mortis ignominiosæ, à proposito suo destiterunt. Si-mile quid in Gallia factum re-censetur, ubi Rex Galliæ jussit aliquando in area minimæ ca-

page.notes: Long s is printed as a letter resembling f (e.g. "erexiffe", "fuperftes", "juffit"); transcribed as s. In the line "congrediendi concef-" / "fisse" the word is read as concessisse, split at the printed hyphen. The line "fi summo" is read as "si summo", and "discrimine" is printed "discrimine" with a long s in the original. The catchword "pa-" is kept only in bottom_margin, not in the text.
